insert.title: Insert pages
insert.description: Insert pages from a source PDF A at the position of your choice in a target PDF B.

insert.targetDescription: The document that receives the inserted pages.
insert.sourceDescription: The document whose pages are copied.
insert.optionsDescription: Choose the pages of A and where to place them in B.
insert.pagesHelp: Leave empty to insert everything. Pages 1 to {{count}}, inserted in the typed order.
insert.outputDescription: PDF B with the pages of A added.
insert.summary_one: {{count}} page inserted after page {{after}} of B.
insert.summary_other: {{count}} pages inserted after page {{after}} of B.
insert.summaryStart_one: {{count}} page inserted at the beginning of B.
insert.summaryStart_other: {{count}} pages inserted at the beginning of B.
insert.filesRequired: Select the target PDF, then the source PDF.
insert.invalidPages: Invalid selection: pages out of range, duplicates or descending range.
insert.invalidPosition: Invalid position for the target PDF.
